record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: Current validated frontier after chatman-ecosystem #148 merge: #145 changed to exact head 15c63419a3a2a4f883ba304a442e7cd19687fc3b and is freshly requalifying; 22 of 23 observed current-head rails are SUCCESS with GALL still IN_PROGRESS. R57 marketplace #275 exact 302fe0be67a89c58665e14f059524f0b0615e6ba has owning R57 court SUCCESS, Vacuity SUCCESS, and CI shards 1/2/3 SUCCESS; shard 0 fails real-ggen qualification. Inherited R56 50-court qualification and R56 combinatorial portfolio also fail, creating a shared R56/R57 compatibility repair frontier. Consumer replication remains the weakest multiplier.
